title: Greer briefed Clinton's CIA director

tellings.quote: 93 94 95 I briefed the CIA director for Clinton in December 13th of 93

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who has long campaigned for governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that he briefed the head of the CIA, America's main spy agency, under President Bill Clinton. He says this happened in Washington on 13 December 1993, part of a stretch of meetings from 1993 to 1995. If true, it would mean the subject reached the top of US intelligence in the 1990s.
